kjv: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints (KJV 11:12)
mine: and Judah still wanders with God, but is faithful to the Holy One
note: rad is obscure ("roam/be restless" or "rule"); qedoshim, a plural of majesty for God parallel to el, is "the Holy One", not "saints"; the line may be praise or censure of Judah.
